sections.title: Stamp Stations
sections.note: 20 Stamp Stations, each with its own stamp. Niko gives the Stamp Book once Alfonzo is home. Tags give the items you need.

items.name: Aboda Village
items.howTo: At the north of the village, just west of Alfonzo's house.

items.name: Forest Sanctuary
items.howTo: On the way to Gage's chamber: hit the switch on the higher platform (or bomb the cracked blocks) to extend the bridge west, and the station is across it.

items.name: Whittleton
items.howTo: Leave the village by the trees at the north-east into the northern part; the station is just north, behind the tree with the beehive.

items.name: Forest Temple
items.howTo: In the north-east of the first floor, inside the poison fog: blow it away with the Whirlwind and follow the path east.

items.name: Anouki Village
items.howTo: From the station go east as far as you can, then north through the trees: the station is hidden in the north-east corner.

items.name: Snow Sanctuary
items.howTo: On the west side, on the way to Steem's chamber: climb the narrow staircase.

items.name: Snow Temple
items.howTo: In the north-east of B1, in the big water room with the Octives and torches: make an ice bridge to the corner with the Boomerang and the cold flame.

items.name: Wellspring Station
items.howTo: Behind Ferrus's hut, at the lake: carry the cold flame across the water with the Boomerang to freeze a path, and the station is just west of the ice torch.

items.name: Castle Town
items.howTo: Bomb the blocks at the top of the north-east staircase, then walk west along the town walls to the north-west corner.

items.name: Trading Post
items.howTo: In the Like Like cave west of Linebeck's house, near the north exit: bomb the block in the way and jump west to the station across the water.

items.name: Ocean Temple
items.howTo: Bomb the cracked walls left and then right of the stairs at the north of 2F. In the hidden part, clear the spiky vines with the Whip and hit the crystal switch with the Boomerang, swing across the poles on the west side, pull the fish statue's handle, then drop onto the moving platform to reach the station.

items.name: Ocean Sanctuary
items.howTo: Just south of the entrance to Carben's cave, play the Song of Birds and hang from the bird with the Whip; it carries you up to the station above the entrance.

items.name: Papuchia Village
items.howTo: Where Carben was flying, hang from a bird with the Whip to reach the island to the south-east, walk south to the southern islands and hop island to island by bird to the south-western one.

items.name: Goron Village
items.howTo: In the west part of the village dodge the rolling boulders to the south-west corner, whip across the two poles, then north across another pole and past the Fire Babas to the north-west corner.

items.name: Fire Sanctuary
items.howTo: Beat the Fire Babas and light every torch with the Boomerang to raise the bridges. Climb the steps, cross the west bridge, go north and cross the long bridge east.

items.name: Fire Temple
items.howTo: In the circular mine-cart room, after hitting the wall switches in order (2, 1, 4, 3), ride clockwise and shoot the hidden switch in the south-west corner with an arrow as you pass; the cart takes you to the station in the north-west.

items.name: Pirate Hideout
items.howTo: From the station go east then north; play the Song of Birds by the cave entrance and hang from the bird with the Whip up to the ledge.

items.name: Sand Temple
items.howTo: In the north of B1: use the Gerune to open the door on the right, then raise a path through the quicksand with the Sand Wand, left, up and right to the station.

items.name: Sand Sanctuary
items.howTo: Once Rael has his five Cuccos, carry one to the south-east shore and glide to the small island, then on to the further one with the station.

items.name: Tower of Spirits
items.area: Top of the Tower of Spirits
items.howTo: After the Sand Temple, take the warp at the top of the stairs, go through Byrne's chamber and outside, and climb to the very top: the station is by the altar.

sections.title: Niko's rewards
sections.note: Show Niko the Stamp Book in your house in Aboda Village.

items.name: 10 stamps
items.howTo: Show Niko 10 stamps.

items.name: 15 stamps
items.howTo: Show Niko 15 stamps.

items.name: All 20 stamps
items.howTo: Show Niko all 20 stamps.
